cause.observed: Installed SDK NSString(string) constructor produces native retain count 2; Dispose clears managed handle but leaves native buffer. Explicit CreateNative + Runtime.GetNSObject<NSString>(owns:true) produces retain count 1 and releases storage. Independent Swift direct WebKit eval has no equivalent retention.
cause.correction: Single native evaluator helper explicitly transfers created input string ownership to a using-scoped wrapper and awaits the NSString overload through native completion. Original callback protocol, acceptance checks and deadlines remain unchanged.
cause.gc_diagnostic_limit: Forced collection used only to separate managed allocations from native retention; it is never pass evidence.
